name: Santasree Choudhury

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Santasree Choudhury, whose work also appears under the spelling Santasree Chaudhuri, writes poetry and makes poetry films. Her literary practice accompanies work for women’s rights through Green Tara Social Initiative. Her poems have appeared in The Chakkar and Setu, and her film If They All Met at Pushkin Cafe grew from one of her poems.

In Kabita Live, “Confession” moves through solitude and the search for a self towards the image of a returning yellow butterfly. “Blooming Freedom” turns from questions of emptiness towards a lotus rising from dark water. Both poems give inward change a visible form through the natural world.
